data.long_meaning: Bhagwan is a Sanskrit name meaning 'God', 'Lord', or 'Blessed One'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhag', which means 'to share' or 'to bless'. In Hinduism, Bhagwan is used as a title for various deities, including Vishnu, Shiva, and Ganesha. The name Bhagwan carries the meaning “God, Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhagwan usually hope their child will grow to embody god, lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
